verdicts.evidence: The gap marker becomes an empty cell: `| ASI07 | Insecure Inter-Agent Communication | **no rule mapped - gap to assess** |` becomes `| ASI07 | Insecure Inter-Agent Communication |  |`. This is the document's ONLY statement that a risk category is unaddressed - deleting it turns a declared gap into a blank cell in a table of otherwise-filled ones, which is a caveat loss of the RWD-2026-0058 kind rather than a typographic one (contrast survivors 21 and 42, where the em dash and the empty cell say the same nothing). Unmapped-category recipe: see survivor 9. Probed: the readiness table line changes while the OSCAL still says `planned`, so the two artefacts disagree.
